title: Warehouse Management and Fulfilment Competitive Landscape

scope.description: Warehouse management software competing with Picqer for webshops, wholesalers and fulfilment companies running their own warehouse, mainly in the Netherlands and Belgium, plus international e-commerce WMS and inventory platforms buyers compare against.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: WMS or inventory/order platforms sold to the same segments that buyers name as alternatives. Excluded: shipping platforms that Picqer integrates with (Sendcloud, MyParcel, DeliveryMatch), Katapull siblings (Logic4's warehouse functions are positioned as a step below Picqer, not a competitor), and enterprise WMS for large logistics providers, which are not modeled in depth.
scope.notes: Figures are company-reported with each company's own scope and are not comparable to Picqer's claims (10% of Dutch online orders, 80+ fulfilment companies). Fetched 30 October 2026.

players.name: Monta (MontaWMS)
players.description: E-commerce fulfilment provider that also sells its own WMS (MontaWMS) and shipping platform (MontaShip). Competes for webshops deciding between running their own warehouse and outsourcing; MontaShip is also listed as a Picqer shipping integration.

businessStats.scope: Fulfilment warehouses in NL, DE, UK and FR, company-reported
Years MontaWMS has run Monta's own warehouses, company-reported

players.name: GoedGepickt
players.description: Dutch warehouse software for webshops and fulfilment companies with their own warehouse; the most direct like-for-like alternative to Picqer for small and mid-size webshops.

businessStats.scope: Webshops whose orders are processed daily, company-reported
Connected sales and shipping platforms, company-reported

players.name: Davanti-WICS (Corax WMS)
players.description: Dutch WMS vendor with WICS for B2B/B2C logistics and Corax, a 100% cloud WMS on Microsoft Azure aimed at e-commerce and fulfilment parties; competes at the upper end of Picqer's range.

players.name: ShipHero
players.description: E-commerce WMS founded in 2013 for brands and 3PLs, also running its own fulfilment network; a benchmark for 3PL-focused WMS features such as billing and pack-to-light, with limited presence in the Benelux.

businessStats.scope: Shipments handled annually by warehouses on ShipHero, company-reported

players.name: Linnworks
players.description: Multichannel inventory and order management platform with warehouse and shipping functions; competes with Picqer for multichannel sellers wanting one hub for listings, stock and orders rather than a dedicated WMS.

businessStats.scope: Brands and retailers, company-reported; 20 years in business
